//: ST-M6: which parts of the sound ROM (6-9f.bin) app/soundDriver.js may read. Only DATA — the sound program itself is transcribed to JavaScript, exactly as the main program is (decision 2026-08-30: the browser gets tables, never a ROM image). Addresses and meanings come from sources/asm/stinger/notes/E.md.

tables.name: romStart
tables.note: E (h): command 0Ch leaves the three AY2 channel pointers at 0000h (07E5-0817 writes them explicitly), so the original plays the start of its own ROM as note data. Reproduced for fidelity — these bytes are read as data here, never executed.

tables.name: cmdTable
tables.note: E (c),(g): the command jump table 0520-0551 read by dispatch_cmd 01A9 (HL = 0520h + A, through L only). Kept as a whole page-aligned block up to 055F so every even command 00-30h resolves from data; odd and out-of-range commands take their pointer from the program code around it, which is transcribed, not shipped (notes/E.md (g): they all end in a reset of the sound CPU).

tables.name: musicLow
tables.note: E (c): note data of commands 02 (0890/08F0/0950 | 09A0/0A10/0A4F) and 04 (0A80/0AA0/0AC0 | 0AE0/0B00/0B20)
